name: Martial Art’s History
description:
About This Game

Martial Art’s History is a 1v1 traditional side-scrolling kung fu fighter shaped by classic Hong Kong martial arts films. Set in early Republican Shanghai, it depicts rival warriors settling grudges and competing for glory on arena stages. Take control of fighters mastering exclusive traditional kung fu to duel friends or strangers.

[h2] Gameplay Intro [/h2]

School Martial Arts: Characters master authentic styles including Hung Gar, Wing Chun, Tai Chi and Drunken Fist. A full system of strikes, grabs, counters and parries delivers weighty, grounded combat based on vintage fight choreography.

Offense & Defense: Light jabs, heavy crushing blows and finishing moves form your toolkit. Matches rely on spacing, reading enemy openings and tactical parrying, with zero over-the-top fantasy effects for pure realistic melee feel.

Arena Stages: Explore period-accurate maps: martial arts halls, open street arenas and old city alleys, built to support hit-and-run and close-quarters brawling tactics.

Battle Modes: Play single-player story or local two-player versus. Combos, blocks and counters create a complete fighting loop accessible for beginners and deep enough for competitive combo players.

[h2] Playable Warriors [/h2]

Unlock 11 original fighters, drawing inspiration from the diverse cast of Republican-era masters seen in classic kung fu cinema.

The roster covers hardened veteran dojo masters and hidden street experts: graceful lounge performers, skilled schoolgirls and quick-witted street youths. Every fighter carries unique backstories and signature moves, with totally distinct fighting styles and personalities.

[h2] Local Versus [/h2]

Duel friends offline to perfect custom combos and fight for supremacy on retro Republican fighting stages.
short_desc: Martial Art’s History: Early Republican China kung fu fighter inspired by classic kung fu films. Play varied warriors with unique authentic martial arts. Retro flat art depicts old dojos and arenas, with single-player story and local 2P duels & solid fluid melee combat.
